spacing_review.reason: Complete the Persian phrase across original rows: تا در آن سال.
spacing_review.note: Accepted. Read against the two joined pieces: the left piece ends with در and the right piece begins with آن; در is followed by آن سال (in that year), so without the space two words would run together. Checked by code point: the inserted character is U+0020 at index 100 of 174; a character that is not a space stands on each side of it; the field has no doubled space; and the mapped pieces of the two sources lie directly before and after it, so the space is the only character added. The row has no Arabic field, so only this one space is in question.
